title.narrative: Protected Within Four Walls: Combating Domestic Violence Against LGBTIQ People in Bosnia and Herzegovina

description.narrative: This Action would contribute to already existing systems of offering different kinds of support to victims of domestic violence being more inclusive to the victims who are LGBTI. Thus, in this sense, it recognizes that there is an element of innovation and use of the already existing systems and mechanisms in place to tackle domestic violence to make them more inclusive for LGBTIQ victims, as is in line with the Istanbul Convention. In this way, it would possibly include gay, bisexual and trans men, which have been excluded and overlooked in the systematic tackling of domestic violence.
